children: U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis said on X that if the Clarity Act does not pass in the current Congress, the next real chance to reintroduce market structure legislation may not come until 2030. According to Odaily, she said passing the bill now would avoid losing jobs, investment, and tax revenue over the next several years.

title: U.S. Senator Cynthia Lummis Says Market Structure Bill May Not Return Until 2030 If Clarity Act Fails
